data.title: Altitude de GRISOGONO
data.about:
Elevate your living standards at Damac Altitude de Grisogono, a symbol of Dubai's architectural innovation. This radiant high-rise not only aligns with the city's glittering skyline but also stands as an invitation to a life beyond the ordinary at Altitude de Grisogono.

Embrace the harmonious blend of tranquil waterfront vibes and bustling city life in Damac Business Bay.  Altitude de Grisogono apartments offer panoramic views that span the dynamic Dubai skyline and serene Dubai Canal, crafting a living experience unlike any other. Within the 38-story Damac Altitude tower, a diverse array of residential choices awaits, including sophisticated studios and 1 to 3 bedroom apartments and 2 bedroom duplexes.

Situated at the nexus of new Dubai, the Altitude de Grisogono by Damac boasts a prestigious location in Business Bay. It's encircled by landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. Residents at Damac Altitude Apartments' enjoy easy access to leisure spots like City Walk and Jumeirah Beach, and proximity to essential amenities including The Dubai Mall, healthcare centers, schools, and hotels. Plus, it's just a 20-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.

characteristics_module.title: Reach New Heights of Luxury at Altitude de Grisogono
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious High-Rise Living: Altitude de GRISOGONO offers premium high-rise residences in Business Bay, Dubai.
  • Easy Down Payment & Flexible Plans: Start with an easy down payment, benefiting from flexible payment options.
  • Premium de GRISOGONO Interiors: Each unit features luxurious interiors designed by renowned brand de GRISOGONO.
  • Elite Facilities and Amenities: Enjoy world-class amenities in the heart of Business Bay.
  • Stunning Views of Dubai: Panoramic views of the Dubai skyline and Dubai Canal from your residence.
  • Prime Business Bay Location: Located in Dubai's prestigious Business Bay, close to major landmarks and amenities.
  • Blend of Urban and Waterfront Lifestyle: Experience a unique mix of vibrant city life and serene waterfront living at Damac Altitude.

location_tile.title: Explore Sophistication at Altitude in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Altitude de Grisogono, a gem in the Damac portfolio, is strategically positioned along the stunning Dubai Canal in Business Bay. This prime location places it in close proximity to other prestigious Damac projects like Canal Heights, Canal Heights 2, Canal Crown, and Aykon City.

Nestled in the heart of new Dubai, Business Bay is a bustling hub that borders the iconic Burj area, famous for landmarks like the Burj Khalifa and Sheikh Zayed Road. Just a short drive from Altitude, you can immerse yourself in the urban chic of City Walk or the enduring charm of Jumeirah Beach.

  • International Horizons College - 6 Mins
  • Business Bay Metro - 8 Mins
  • Burj Khalifa/ Dubai Mall - 10 Mins
  • Emirates Hospital Clinic - 11 Mins
